top_choice_rationale: Optical-lattice quantum simulators established a mature, broadly reproducible laboratory in which tunable many-body Hamiltonians can be prepared and tested microscopically. Bloch, Greiner, and Zoller provide the most coherent experimental-theoretical attribution for the citation's narrowly defined achievement.
recusal_note: No specific connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from the supplied profile. My long-standing attosecond collaborations do not involve these candidates.
